Reads the CONFIG.TXT file of an AudioMoth

Source: R/config.R
read_config.Rd

Format: one line per setting, Key<spaces>: value. Keys contain no ":" but values do (times), so each line is split at the first one. A value of "-" means "not applicable". Unknown keys are kept (other firmware versions add fields).

Usage

read_config(file)

Arguments

file

Path to the CONFIG.TXT file.

Value

A list of class audiomoth_config with settings (all the key/value pairs as text) and the interpreted fields: device_id, firmware, device_time_utc, sample_rate, gain, sleep_s, recording_s, periods (data frame), sun_mode, trigger, first_date, last_date, utc_offset_h and location (list with lat, lon and precision_m, or NULL when the file has no location).

Examples

card <- system.file("extdata", "example", "card", package = "AudiomothR")
read_config(file.path(card, "CONFIG.TXT"))
#> 
#> ── AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 ──
#> 
#> • Firmware: AudioMoth-Firmware-Basic (1.12.1)
#> • Sample rate: 48,000 Hz, gain Medium
#> • Cycle: 60 s recording / 240 s sleeping
#> • Sun recording mode: Sunrise and sunset
#> • Dates: 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-30
#> • Location: 41, -3 (±698 m)
